stem: Jace would like a more effective closing sentence for the third paragraph (sentences 7–10). Which sentence can BEST replace sentence 10 and help Jace accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: Jessie reached for one more biscuit and added, “I hope we have these again for breakfast tomorrow.”

options.label: B
options.text: Jessie looked at his brother Juan and said, “Later today, let’s go for a swim in the hotel pool.”

options.label: C
options.text: Jessie glanced out the window and added, “The sun’s just coming up over the horizon, so we’d better get going.”

options.label: D
options.text: Jessie adjusted his cap and said, “I’m glad I got this new ball cap before we left home.”
